class Order(models.Model):
    order_no = models.IntegerField(primary_key=True)
    state = models.CharField(max_length=32, choices=OrderState.choices, default=OrderState.NEW)
    placed_at = models.DateTimeField(default=timezone.now)
    subtotal = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2)
    tax = models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, default=0)
    total = models.GeneratedField(expression=subtotal + tax, output_field=models.DecimalField(max_digits=12, decimal_places=2, null=True, blank=True), db_persist=True)
    customer = models.ForeignKey("Customer", on_delete=models.PROTECT, related_name="orders")

    class Meta:
        db_table = "orders"
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=["placed_at", "customer"], name="orders_placed_idx"),
        ]
